name: Low-stock digest for AI assistants
description: Adds a low-stock digest tool that AI assistants can use, with your own stock threshold. Read-only; assign the tool to an assistant in AI Studio.

threshold.title: Treat as low stock at or below

ai_tools.name: low_stock_digest
ai_tools.description: Variants whose available stock is at or below the store's configured low-stock threshold.

docs: Enable, then add the tool “x_voltora_low_stock_assistant_low_stock_digest” to an assistant (e.g. Owner copilot).
